slug: 2025-11-19 Togo Advances Digital ID Program With New Enrollment Phase in Maritime Region

facts.fact: Togo's National Identification Agency (ANID) is expanding e-ID biometric enrolment to Maritime region Zone 1 from 22 November 2025, after rollouts in the Gulf, Agoe-Nyive and Savanes prefectures, assigning residents a Unique Identification Number (NIU) and issuing biometric identity cards.
